description: Source code for MTA hardware abstraction layer (HAL) wrapper functions, including API calls for device parameters, diagnostics, provisioning, logs, and status management.

methods.name: ssp_MTAHAL_GetParamCharValue
methods.description: Retrieves character parameter values from the MTA HAL based on parameter name.

methods.name: ssp_MTAHAL_GetParamUlongValue
methods.description: Retrieves unsigned long parameter values from the MTA HAL based on parameter name.

methods.name: ssp_MTAHAL_SetParamUlongValue
methods.description: Sets unsigned long parameter values in the MTA HAL based on parameter name.

methods.name: ssp_MTAHAL_GetDHCPInfo
methods.description: Retrieves DHCP information from the MTA HAL.

methods.name: ssp_MTAHAL_GetLineTableGetEntry
methods.description: Gets a specific line table entry by index from the MTA HAL.

methods.name: ssp_MTAHAL_TriggerDiagnostics
methods.description: Triggers diagnostics on the MTA device for a specific line.

methods.name: ssp_MTAHAL_GetServiceFlow
methods.description: Retrieves all service flow information from the MTA HAL.

methods.name: ssp_MTAHAL_GetCalls
methods.description: Retrieves call information for a specific line from the MTA HAL.

methods.name: ssp_MTAHAL_GetCALLP
methods.description: Retrieves call progress information for a specific line number.

methods.name: ssp_MTAHAL_GetDSXLogs
methods.description: Retrieves DSX logs from the MTA HAL.

methods.name: ssp_MTAHAL_GetMtaLog
methods.description: Retrieves full MTA logs.

methods.name: ssp_MTAHAL_getDhcpStatus
methods.description: Gets DHCP status for IPv4 and IPv6 from the MTA HAL.

methods.name: ssp_MTAHAL_getConfigFileStatus
methods.description: Gets configuration file status from the MTA HAL.

methods.name: ssp_MTAHAL_getLineRegisterStatus
methods.description: Gets registration status for all lines.

methods.name: ssp_MTAHAL_GetHandsets
methods.description: Retrieves handset information from the MTA HAL.

methods.name: ssp_MTAHAL_InitDB
methods.description: Initializes the MTA database.

methods.name: ssp_MTAHAL_devResetNow
methods.description: Resets the MTA device immediately.

methods.name: ssp_MTAHAL_getMtaOperationalStatus
methods.description: Gets the operational status of the MTA device.

methods.name: ssp_MTAHAL_start_provisioning
methods.description: Starts IP provisioning with specified parameters.

methods.name: ssp_MTAHAL_LineRegisterStatus_callback_register
methods.description: Registers callback for line registration status updates.

methods.name: ssp_MTAHAL_getMtaProvisioningStatus
methods.description: Retrieves provisioning status of the MTA.
